Star Fish Company.verification: Flickr photo 32449700360 by Carol VanHook, titled Cortez Scenic Spot, description reads Starfish Co.; taken 2017-02-10. Viewed the full image: the STARFISH CO. lettering is visible on the building behind the deck, alongside the working-waterfront docks and boats that match the Cortez location. Diners at the tables are incidental and mid-distance, not the subject; no children in focus. Live Flickr licence checked: CC BY-SA 2.0.
